long_biography.plain_text:
While directing the social-sector department of a Carinthian public authority, Otto Scheiflinger saw the low standards then common in care homes. He wanted to create facilities he would trust for his own parents. Although trained in law rather than nursing, he completed the required operating examination and combined his administrative experience with his wife's clinical expertise.

The resulting first generation park opened in Klagenfurt in 1993. Scheiflinger subsequently extended its home-like model across several Austrian regions, adding nursing, dementia support and related social services. Wie daham remains privately held and family-run, without external corporate shareholders. Scheiflinger continues as owner and managing director, while a younger generation has assumed responsibilities within the group.
